text:
emily: Heads-up 5 OceanBridge pilot case draft is ready but legal flagged two benchmark lines. Need a quick thread to resolve before we schedule the webinar. Can legal review by EOD Mon?
raj: Paste the problematic lines pls. I'll ping OceanBridge for confirmation if we need to tweak numbers.
emily: Here9s the excerpt: "OceanBridge saw a 3x improvement in median latency and a 45% reduction in inference cost after migrating to Redwood.9"
tasha: Legal-bot: redline recommendation: change '3x' -> 'threefold' and '45%' -> 'approximately 45%'. Also recommend specifying metric type: 'median latency' -> 'median end-to-end latency (p50)'.
liam: Ops note 5 webinar timing: two candidate dates May 12 or May 19. Which gives more runway? Prefer May 19 to allow for legal + design.
priya: I'll prepare the landing page with hidden_field=campaign=oceanbridge and route leads to APAC_AE queue; tag @liam for demo assignments.
raj: OceanBridge comms replied: they're comfortable with 'threefold' and 'approximately 45%'. They also ask to remove the exact model name and instead say 'open-source LLM family'.
tasha: Good. Also request an explicit email from OceanBridge that says: 'We grant Redwood permission to publish the quote and logo on or after May 20, 2026.' Need that for the release.
emily: I just asked for the signed approval email and the svg logo. Asked them to confirm the publish date May 20.
legal-bot: Reminder 5 include: logo usage terms, any co-marketing restrictions, and confirm anonymized revenue band if mentioned.
liam: Design will make a generic hero slide 'Reducing inference costs at scale' and swap in OceanBridge logo after approval. Will provide slide + social assets 48hrs before publish.
priya: Routing set 5 I'll queue nurture emails: teaser, reminder, replay. Lead form will include hidden field and utm_campaign=oceanbridge_pilot.
emily: Updated quote (verbatim from OceanBridge CTO):
"Redwood helped us achieve a threefold improvement in median end-to-end latency (p50) and reduced inference costs by approximately 45%, enabling faster releases."

raj: Perfect. Once we have the email approval, I9ll add the quote release to the contract folder.
tasha: On standby. If approval arrives by Tue EOD, legal can clear for May 20 publish with May 19 webinar.
calendar-bot: Event created 5 "OceanBridge webinar prep" May 19 10:00 PT 5 invites sent to emily,raj,tasha,liam,priya
liam: I'll enable recording and request transcript export. Also will grab 1-2 headshots during the session.
emily: Checklist: 1) Email approval + logo (raj) 2) Legal sign-off (tasha) 3) Assets uploaded (raj -> /shared/marketing/oceanbridge) 4) Slides + onepager (liam) 5) Landing page + lead routing (priya) 6) Webinar date May 19, publish May 20.
priya: Setting nurture start to May 17 pending legal greenlight.
emily: Thanks team 5 will update when I have the approval email. :thumbsup:
